name: Polearm Craft's chance/damage bonus only applies with a polearm equipped (#3159)
contract: 707885 'Polearm Craft' reads 'While a polearm is equipped, your chance to trigger your Weapon Crafts and their damage dealt is increased by 25%.' It is a passive with a single SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL effect (amplitude 10000 ms) casting 712481 every 10 sec. 712481 carries three APPLY_AURA effects on the same class mask (word2/5/8 = 262144): ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 18 = SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS (BasePoints 24+1=25), and two ADD_PCT_MODIFIER effects, MiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE and MiscValue 22 = SPELLMOD_DOT (BasePoints 24+1=25% each), DurationIndex 38 (11000 ms), and EquippedItemClass 2/EquippedItemSubClassMask 64 (polearm) -- the identical shape to Ambuscade's 707887 (#2496). 712481 is not passive, so every periodic retrigger runs through Spell::CheckCast/CheckItems, which fails SPELL_FAILED_EQUIPPED_ITEM_CLASS without a polearm equipped; the aura's 11 sec duration outlives the 10 sec retrigger by 1 sec so a continuously-equipped polearm keeps it refreshed. Item 1406 'Pearl-encrusted Spear' (item_template: class 2, subclass 6 Polearm, AllowableClass -1, RequiredLevel 20, RequiredSkill 0) is a real, unconditionally usable polearm.
